newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record on NY, Astra rebound.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record on NY, Astra rebound.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at record highs on Friday after recovering late in the session when New York opened stronger and pharmaceutical company Astra came off intra-day lows.
The general index rose 0.21 to 2,478.08 in turnover of 4.89 billion crowns.
Astra ended flat at 330.5 crowns in a late rebound after hitting a day low of 325 when investors put pressure on the share as options were called at the 330 crown level on Friday.
"Many had an interest in seeing Astra closing down," a broker said.
Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz dropped 45 crowns to 1050 amid media and broker reports that the share was overpriced.
"Many players are probably choosing to adjust (their holdings in H&M) downwards ahead of the earnings report, which surely will mean large share price movements," a trader said.
Vehicle maker Volvo rose 1.5 to 166.5 in lively trade after company says truck sales fell 17 percent 1996.
"It's the only share in which there's any real interest today," a broker said earlier.
